journeyObjective: Review savings knowledge progress and smoothly transition into the next self-paced educational module.
completionDefinition: Customer views goal progress, checks points balance, and engages with an educational insight or quiz card.
episodeSketches: Episode 1: Open with Points Balance and First Home Savings Knowledge Goal Progress (63% complete) to ground current mastery state.
Episode 2: Present Educational Insight Card and Rewards Insight Card detailing milestone progress without timed pressure.
Episode 3: Provide Quiz Card for self-directed practice, exiting upon module engagement.
